parent.old_dev_results: P46 0/3 hypothesis gain FAIL; preserve and never reseed as new science

hypothesis: A classical change-point selector with explicit exogenous alternatives can recover the post-switch causal action effect better than recency, trailing 5/3 factual interventions, and a no-switch fit without mistaking exogenous shocks for causal switches.

source.executed_actions: alternating +/-1 with randomly chosen initial sign

groups.exogenous: 25%, nuisance step signed magnitude uniform .4..7 at k=3/4/5, beta unchanged

methods.candidate: BIC selection among no-switch X=[1,t,t²,a], causal switch X=[1,t,t²,a,a*I(i>=k)], and nuisance shock X=[1,t,t²,a,I(i>=k)], all k=3/4/5, extra log(3) complexity penalty on change models
methods.weighted: 8-fact recency weighted LS same features, exp(-.7*(7-i))
methods.oracle: beta only for evaluator, never passed to any estimator

criteria.causal_MAE: candidate <= .85 * min(trailing5, weighted, last5) each cohort
criteria.cold: byte-identical replay from eight factual actions and outcomes

numerical.BIC: n*log(max(SSE,1e-10)/n)+p*log(n), add log(3) search penalty for changed model
